title: Five Places to Go in Seattle
abstract: As Seattle becomes increasingly unaffordable, unincorporated White Center is attracting a diverse blend of residents and entrepreneurs.

title: Five Places to Go in Bali
abstract: This peaceful haven for expat surfers has lately seen an uptick in hip new options like vegan cafes, music bars and housewares shops.

title: Five Places to Go in Amsterdam
abstract: A repurposed gasworks complex, built in the 19th century, has spurred a revival of the industrial neighborhood of Westerpark.

title: Five Places to Go in Austin
abstract: There are still used car lots and lighting stores along Austin’s Burnet Road, but this well-trafficked thoroughfare is fast becoming a hot spot.
